fix: require patched Node runtimes for repository builds (#2791)

* fix: require patched Node runtimes for repository builds

Use supported Node security floors for CI, CodeQL, Pages, npm, and Rush. Resolve current patches instead of accepting vulnerable cached runtimes and document runner provisioning requirements.

Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

* fix: pin patched decoder dependency to its patch target

Keep the Rush override and lockfile on decode-uri-component 0.5.0 so full dependency resolution cannot select a version without the required CommonJS patch.

Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>
